questions.question: What caused the scar on Toji's lip?
questions.subject: Toji Fushiguro/Synopsis

answer.item: he would be abused and thrown into the disciplinary pit full of cursed spirits, which caused him to obtain a scar on his lip

questions.question: How did Toji come to have the surname Fushiguro?
questions.subject: Toji Fushiguro/Synopsis

answer.item: Toji eventually married a woman and took her surname, becoming Toji Fushiguro.

questions.question: How did Toji break through Gojo's Infinity?
questions.subject: Toji Fushiguro/Synopsis

answer.item: Attacking from Gojo's blind spot, Toji broke through his Infinity and stabbed him in the throat using the Inverted Spear of Heaven

questions.question: What did Toji tell Gojo with his dying words?
questions.subject: Toji Fushiguro/Synopsis

answer.item: Toji told his killer that his son will be sold to the Zenin Clan in two or three years, and to do whatever he wanted with that information.

questions.question: How did Toji show up during the Shibuya Incident?
questions.subject: Toji Fushiguro/Synopsis

answer.item: Ogami used her Séance Technique to summon Toji's body's information into her grandson, physically transforming him into Toji to gain his physical abilities.

questions.question: What is Toji doing in Gojo's afterlife?
questions.subject: Toji Fushiguro/Synopsis

answer.item: Toji appeared in Gojo's afterlife, wandering in the background.
